previousFailures.failure: Latest run installed the ordinary SDK 32 app, then the guest zygote service pocket-framework (PID 1297) exited with signal 31 (SIGSYS); init restarted it as PID 3988. The app probe subsequently received DeadObjectException while releasing its ActivityManager external provider reference. The triggering syscall/reason is not yet identified. The layout-versioned pixel gate and valid-host descriptor handshake were not reached. No host tap was sent.

previousFailures.cause: App launched before asynchronous package-removal/replacement processing completed; AMS subsequently removed the just-started activity.
Standalone app_process receiver had no registered ApplicationThread; stock BroadcastQueue skipped its receiver as process gone or crashing.
Target MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED manifest receiver did not persist a current-install receipt within the deadline. Replaced with an independently registered ordinary-app observer.

previousFailures.failure: The correct current-nonce app pixels matched all 16 samples in the composer buffer and host Surface PixelCopy. The driver tapped the matching current-layout button. The host-owner PID/UID and kernel-stat-descriptor handshake succeeded, and IInputManager asynchronously queued both touch events, but the ordinary app click counter stayed zero for 90 seconds. Queue acceptance does not establish guest dispatch. The subsequent compositor EOF was recorded during failed-test cleanup. Input delivery remains unverified.

The driver tapped host coordinate 240,281 after 16 current-nonce host pixels matched. InputControl32 queued DOWN and UP at guest coordinate 240.0,219.41449, within the published current-layout button at 240,220, but the ordinary app click counter stayed zero. Input/power/window diagnostic dumps were denied: native Binder DUMP exposed the host UID 10154 because that control transaction was excluded from guest-role attribution. Correct-geometry queueing is proven; dispatcher/window/power cause remains unresolved. Cleanup reaped 28 services with zero remaining or failed.
